importantTopics: Basic Programs: Strings, Patterns and Arrays
likelyQuestions: Explain the life cycle of a thread. Why do we use the Runnable interface? Write a program using multiple threads.
Explain the life cycle of an applet and create an applet with labels, text fields and a submit button.
Write a Java program to remove all vowels from a string entered by the user / print a reverse pyramid pattern.
Differentiate between constructor overloading and constructor chaining with a Box class example.
Differentiate between ad-hoc and pure polymorphism, and between early and late binding.
Explain the access modifiers in Java. What is a package and how is it used?
Explain try, catch, throw, throws and finally with examples.
What is serialization and deserialization? Write a program to store Employee objects in a file and read them back.
Differentiate between class, instance and local variables. Write a program where a class variable auto-assigns unique roll numbers to Student objects.
What are the forms of inheritance in Java? Why is multiple inheritance not allowed and how is it achieved using interfaces?
